title: Battlepack section 59 — Story Point Additions (extended info)

container.notes: Section 59 of battle_pack.bin (71-section battlepack: u32 count, count+1 u32 file offsets incl. an unpadded end offset, sections 16-byte aligned with zero fill; see container-battlepack). The section is an st2e table: 32-byte header (magic, u32 entryCount @4, u16 entrySize @8 = 44, u32 entryListOffset @12 = 32, u32 textSectionOffset @20 = 0) followed by entryCount packed 44-byte entries and zero padding to a multiple of 16 bytes (see container-st2e).

fields.name: magic
fields.notes: ASCII 'st2e' (73 74 32 65); reject the section if different.

fields.name: entryCount
fields.notes: Number of per-member records.

fields.name: entrySize
fields.notes: Bytes per entry; 44 (0x2C) for this section.

fields.name: unknown0A
fields.notes: Not interpreted; keep.

fields.name: entryListOffset
fields.notes: Offset of entry 0 from the section start: 32 when entryCount > 0, else 0.

fields.name: offset10
fields.notes: Unknown offset slot (0 in Workshop output).

fields.name: textSectionOffset
fields.notes: Inline text offset; 0 on disk for this section (filled at run time). No strings are stored here.

fields.name: offset18
fields.notes: Unknown offset slot (0 in Workshop output for this section).

fields.name: offset1C
fields.notes: Unknown offset slot (0 in Workshop output).

records.name: storyPointMember
records.where: st2e entries of section 59: header.entryListOffset + i*44; each row is one party member at one story point (basicInfoLink -> section 60 row)

fields.name: basicInfoLink
fields.notes: Section 60 row (story point) this record belongs to.

fields.name: partyMember
fields.notes: Party member (section 16 row) affected.

fields.name: level
fields.notes: Level set for the member.

fields.name: mistBars
fields.notes: Mist bars set for the member.

fields.name: weapon
fields.notes: Equipped weapon.

fields.name: offhand
fields.notes: Equipped off-hand (shield/ammunition).

fields.name: helm
fields.notes: Equipped helm.

fields.name: armor
fields.notes: Equipped armor.

fields.name: accessory
fields.notes: Equipped accessory.

fields.name: gambitSet
fields.notes: Default gambit set, stored as 0x5000 + section 8 row.

fields.name: unknown10
fields.notes: Not read; the Workshop leaves zeros.

fields.name: lp
fields.notes: License points given/set.

fields.name: unknown22
fields.notes: Not read; the Workshop leaves zeros.

fields.name: currentMpPercentage
fields.notes: Current MP as a percentage of max.

fields.name: flags
fields.notes: Only bit 0 is known; the Workshop rebuilds the byte from it (other bits become 0).

fields.name: unknown2A
fields.notes: Not read; the Workshop leaves zeros.

roundTrip: Edit fields in place; the record size is fixed and nothing in this section points at entries, so value edits never move data.

Copy every byte that no field interprets (unknown*/padding, unnamed bits) from the original; the Workshop writer zero-fills them (it seeks over them), so do not use its output as the byte-identical reference.
Keep the st2e header bytes verbatim except entryCount (and entryListOffset when the count goes to/from 0).
Keep the trailing zero padding that rounds the section to a multiple of 16 bytes.
If the section length changes (added/removed entries), rewrite the battlepack offset table: every later section offset and the end offset shift by the padded size delta.
flags (0x29): change only bit 0 and preserve bits 1-7.
gaps: Bytes 0x10-0x1F, 0x22-0x27 and 0x2A-0x2B are never read (could be stats/status fields as in section 16).
Whether lp/level are absolute values or additions.
